prefix:
6.1.2.2  QCLASS Values: RFC-1035 Section 3.2.5

            A query with "QCLASS=*" SHOULD NOT be used unless the
            requestor is seeking data from more than one class.  In
            particular, if the requestor is only interested in Internet
            data types, QCLASS=IN MUST be used.
held_constant: The table header and row; one 'x' moves from SHOULD to SHOULD NOT.
notes: The summary table contradicts the requirement level the prefix established.

weak.locator: Section 6.1.5 summary table header and row, published

source_framing.text: This contradicts the guidance in Section 6.1.2.2 which states that QCLASS=* "SHOULD NOT be used unless the requestor is seeking data from more than one class."
